title: Bazaar mein Binte Ali
body:
Bazaar mei bint-e-Ali
Bazaar mei bint-e-Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
(Aina Akhi Abbas) x 4
(Bazaar Mai Binte-Ali Deti Thi Sadaa Bhai Abbas Kahaan Ho) x 2
(Sar Par Bhi Nahi Chaadar) x 2 Laakhon Hai Tamashaai
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Aalam-e-Ghurbat Mai Koi Bhi Nahi Meraa, Hai Khaake Safar Sar Par Aur Haath Rasan Bastaa, Pardes Mai Zainab Ko Taqdeer Kahaan Laayi
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Paivast Hai Neze Mai Sar Shaahe Shahidaan Ka, Yeh Dekh Ke Ai Ghaazi Phat-taa Hai Mera Sina, Marjaaegi Is Gham Mai, Shabbir Ki Majaayee
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Dariyaa Ke Kanaare Tum Aadaa Se Gaye Larne, Sab Dekh Rahi Thi Mai Darvaaza-e-Khaima Se, Ab Jung Hamaari Bhi Dekho To Zaraa Bhai
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniyo Ka Sahara Hai Baba Jo Hamaraa Hai, Mushkil Mai Magar Maine Tumko Hi Pukaara Hai, Ab Dhundhti Hai Tumko Bhayya Meri Binaai
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Be Munis-o-Yawar Hai Batlaawo Kidhar Jaaye, Is Tarha To Jine se Behtar Hai Ke Marjaaye, Fariyaad Kare Kisse Hoti Nahi Sunwaayi
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ai Sher Yehi Meri Imdaad Ko Aajaao
Maanga Hai Kanizi Mai Zaalim Ne Sakina Ko
Hai Waqt Qayamat Ka Maasum Hai Ghabraayi
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahmed Ki Nawaasi Ka "Yassir" Yehi Nauha Thaa
Na Bhaai Bache Mere Na Koi Bachaa Beta
Ab Jiike Karungi Kya Gar Maut Nahi Aayi
<<MINI>>
Abbas (Kahaan Ho) x 2 (Abbas Abbas) x 4
